name: native-base
rules: Write semantic HTML. button, input, select, textarea, dialog, details, table, progress and meter are styled with no classes.

Composite components use one data attribute as their hook: data-card, data-badge, data-alert, data-avatar, data-tabs, data-carousel, data-toast, data-tooltip, data-breadcrumb, data-navbar, data-shell, data-section, data-stat, data-chart, data-steps, data-timeline, data-segmented, …
Variants on any component: data-variant="secondary|outline|ghost|link|destructive|success|warning". Sizes: data-size="sm|lg|icon".
Open overlays with invoker commands, not JS: <button commandfor="id" command="show-modal|close|toggle-popover|show-popover">, or popovertarget="id".
Layout: data-row (wrapping flex, =between|end|center), data-stack (vertical), data-grid (responsive columns). Tune with style="--gap:…" or "--min:…".

Theme with shadcn/ui CSS variables: colors (--primary, --background, …) are the theme; --spacing, --radius, --corner-shape, --font-sans, --text-sm, --weight, --shadow, --duration and friends are the style. Install one of each with npx native-base theme <theme> --style <style> (see `native-base list themes`). Everything lives in @layer nb.*, so unlayered CSS always wins.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: Theme variables (shadcn/ui names) for color, style variables for spacing, shape, type and motion, automatic light/dark with light-dark(), and the shared variant vocabulary.

api.--spacing: Base unit (.25rem); every padding, gap and control height is a multiple of it
api.--radius, --corner-shape, --border-width: Shape. --corner-shape: round | squircle | superellipse(n) | bevel | notch | scoop | square
api.[name=color-scheme]: Any select or radio group with this name switches the page theme, no JS
api.data-variant: secondary | outline | ghost | link | destructive | success | warning

items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: A small reset plus typography for headings, paragraphs, lists, code, kbd, mark and focus rings.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: Three layout primitives that cover most screens: row, stack and grid.

api.data-row: Wrapping flex row. Values: between | end | center

items.name: transitions
items.title: Page transitions
items.description: Cross-document view transitions for every same-origin navigation. Crossfade by default, slide on request.

api.html[data-transition]: slide | none. Also pins body > header in place
api.view-transition-name: Set on any element to morph it between pages

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Plain <button> elements. Variants and sizes are data attributes; links become buttons with data-variant.

api.<a data-variant>: A link styled as a button
api.data-group: Wrap buttons or inputs to join their edges

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text inputs, textarea, file and range. Labels wrap fields, and validation messages appear without JS.

api.<label>Text <input></label>: Label wraps the field, no for/id needed
api.<small data-hint>: Shown until the field is invalid
api.<small data-error>: Shown only after the user makes the field invalid

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox & Radio
items.description: Custom-drawn checkboxes and radios that keep native semantics, keyboard support and form participation.

api.<input type=radio>: Group with a shared name inside <fieldset>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A checkbox that looks like a switch.

api.<input type=checkbox role=switch>: Switch in every browser (Safari also accepts the switch attribute)

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, upgraded to a fully styleable picker where appearance: base-select is supported.

api.<select>: Works everywhere, styled picker where supported
api.<button><selectedcontent></selectedconte: Optional: mirror rich option HTML into the closed select

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A radio group drawn as a pill track. The highlight slides between options with CSS anchor positioning.

api.<fieldset data-segmented>: Container. Name it with aria-label or a <legend> (the legend is visually hidden)
api.<label><input type=radio name> Text</lab: One option; all share a name. Segments are equal width; an svg icon may sit beside or replace the text (then put aria-label on the input)

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star ratings: a radio group to pick one, or a read-only score with fractional fill.

api.<fieldset data-rating>: Input: five radios sharing a name, each with an aria-label ("3 stars"). An optional visible <legend> labels it
api.<span data-rating style=\"--value: 4.5\": Read-only score out of 5, filled fractionally
api.data-size: sm | lg. Stars scale with the font size

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file input with a large drop target. Dropping onto it is the browser's own behavior.

api.<label data-dropzone>: The drop area. Children: optional svg, strong, small, and the <input type=file>
api.<input type=file multiple accept>: Covers the area invisibly, so a drop lands on it. With required, the border turns solid once a file is chosen
api.<small data-hint> / <small data-error>: Optional; the error replaces the hint after an invalid submit
api.data-size=\"sm\": Compact single row, icon at the start

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress & Meter
items.description: Determinate, indeterminate and threshold-colored bars from <progress> and <meter>.

api.<meter value low high optimum>: Colors itself green, amber or red

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with optional header and footer slots.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status labels.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callouts for important messages, with an optional icon.

api.data-alert: Container. Children: optional svg, strong, p
api.role=\"alert\": Add when the message appears dynamically

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round image or initials, with overlapping groups.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Readable data tables straight from <table> markup.

api.<table>: thead, tbody, tfoot and caption are styled
api.data-numeric: Right-aligned tabular numbers on th or td

items.name: loading
items.title: Skeleton & Spinner
items.description: Placeholders and busy states.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are in the site hierarchy.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Key numbers for dashboards and landing pages, with an up or down trend.

api.data-stat: Container. Children: small (label), optional svg after it (icon at the row end), strong (value), p (context), or a data-chart="spark"
api.<span data-trend=\"up|down\">: Change, colored and arrowed; sits beside the value. Add data-variant="success|destructive" when down is good (or up is bad); any other value is a neutral pill

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Column and bar charts from a list and one custom property per item. Values grow in on load.

api.<ul data-chart style=\"--max: 100\" aria: Column chart. data-chart="bars" for horizontal bars, data-chart="spark" for a label-less sparkline
api.<li style=\"--v: 40\"><span>Label</span>: One datum; --v and --max are unitless. The span is its label (visually hidden in a sparkline). In bars, a second child such as <data value> is the value column

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Activity feeds and changelogs: a vertical line of events.

api.<li>: Event. Children: time, strong, p, then anything (badges, a card). An svg or [data-avatar] first child replaces the dot
api.data-variant: success | warning | destructive on an li colors its dot

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a page shows before there is anything to show.

api.data-empty: Container. Children: svg (icon), h2–h4, p, and an actions [data-row]. Drops its dashed border inside a td or data-card

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog & Sheet
items.description: Modal dialogs and edge sheets on <dialog>. Opened with invoker commands, animated in and out with CSS.

api.command=close: Closes it. As the dialog's first child it becomes the corner ✕
api.closedby=\"any\": Close on backdrop click and Esc
api.data-side: left | right | bottom turns it into a sheet

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Light-dismiss floating panels anchored to their trigger with CSS anchor positioning. No ids in CSS, no JS.

api.<div popover id>: The panel, positioned under its trigger

items.name: menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A <menu> popover of buttons and links.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: One-attribute tooltips drawn with attr(). For richer content use popover=hint.

api.data-tooltip=\"text\": Shows on hover and keyboard focus (not on void elements like input)

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A corner notification built from <output popover>.

api.<output popover data-toast id>: The toast, announced by screen readers
api.command=show-popover: Show it from a button, or call showPopover()

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: A site header whose links collapse into a popover menu when the bar gets narrow. A container query decides, so it also works inside sidebars and previews.

api.<header data-navbar>: The bar, its content aligned with data-section at --max (default 72rem). data-navbar="sticky" pins it with a translucent backdrop
api.> nav[popover][id]: Links. Inline when the bar is at least 48rem wide, otherwise a dropdown. aria-current="page" marks the active one
api.> button[popovertarget]: Menu button (an svg and aria-label). Only shown when the bar is narrow; ghost unless it has a data-variant
api.> div: Trailing actions, pushed to the end

items.name: shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The frame of an app: a sidebar of navigation beside the page. On small screens the sidebar becomes a popover.

api.<div data-shell>: Sidebar beside the page. Below 56rem of width (a container query) the sidebar becomes a sheet
api.> aside[popover][id]: Sidebar. Children: a brand link, nav (ul of links with optional svg and trailing small or [data-badge]; small group labels or details/summary groups), footer (pinned to the bottom)
api.button[popovertarget] data-shell-toggle: Opens the sidebar on small screens; hidden on large ones
api.--height: Shell height, default 100dvh. Set it to show the shell inside a smaller box

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with previous and next.

api.<li><a>: Page link. aria-current="page" for the current one
api.a[rel=prev], a[rel=next]: Previous and next with an arrow. aria-disabled="true" at either end

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow. Steps before the current one are marked done.

api.<ol data-steps>: Horizontal; stacks by itself when narrower than 32rem. data-steps="vertical" always stacks
api.aria-current=\"step\": The current step; earlier ones show a check

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Animated <details>. Share a name to allow only one open at a time.

api.name=\"group\": Exclusive: opening one closes the others

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Exclusive <details> laid out as tabs. Falls back to an accordion.

api.<details name open><summary>: One tab, all sharing a name

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Scroll-snap slides with CSS-generated prev/next buttons and dots.

api.--slide: Slide width, e.g. 50% to show two

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: Page sections for marketing and content pages: a centered column, an intro header, split layouts and a browser frame for product shots.

api.<section data-section>: Full-bleed band with its content centered at --max (default 72rem)
api.> header: Intro: small (eyebrow) or [data-badge], h1/h2, p (lead), [data-row] (actions). Centered; start-aligned inside data-split
api.data-tone=\"muted|primary\": Band background. primary inverts the colors inside, buttons included. Use data-theme="dark" for a dark band
api.<div data-split>: Two equal columns from any two children; they wrap to one when there is no room. data-split="reverse" swaps them side by side
api.<div data-frame>: Browser-window chrome around any content. data-frame="app.acme.com" shows an address. An img or data-shell bleeds to the edges; anything else is padded

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endlessly scrolling row for logo clouds and testimonials. Pauses on hover; still under reduced motion.

api.<div data-marquee>: Container. data-marquee="reverse" scrolls the other way
api.> ul: The items. Repeat the list once with aria-hidden="true" so the loop is seamless

templates.name: landing
templates.title: SaaS landing page
templates.description: A complete product homepage: sticky navbar, hero with a live dashboard in a browser frame, logo marquee, features, a bento of live UI, stats, pricing, testimonials, FAQ and footer.

templates.name: dashboard
templates.title: Analytics dashboard
templates.description: A store analytics dashboard in an app shell: KPI cards with trends and sparklines, a revenue column chart, top sources as bars, an activity timeline, and an orders table with selection, row menus and pagination.

templates.name: settings
templates.title: Account settings
templates.description: Account settings in an app shell: tabs for profile (photo dropzone, validated fields), notification switches, billing with usage meters and invoices, and team members with an invite dialog and a typed-confirmation delete.

templates.name: mail
templates.title: Mail inbox
templates.description: A three-pane mail client: folders and labels in the app shell sidebar, a filterable message list, and a reading pane with an action toolbar, attachments and a reply box.

templates.name: pricing
templates.title: Pricing page
templates.description: Plans with a monthly and yearly toggle, an enterprise band, a grouped feature comparison table and a billing FAQ.

templates.name: product
templates.title: Product page
templates.description: An e-commerce product page with a gallery, options, ratings, reviews and shipping details.

templates.name: sign-in
templates.title: Sign in
templates.description: A full-height sign-in page: social providers, a validated email and password form, and a live product preview with a star-rated testimonial beside it.

templates.name: changelog
templates.title: Changelog
templates.description: Release notes on a timeline, with tags, live UI previews in browser frames, a subscribe form and pagination.
